title: Horny in Your Heart
summary: A Big Bear recording retreat built around Money Mark and Steve Lee's album begins with severe eating-disorder behavior. David describes diabetes risk, chewing and spitting cheesecake, pizza and donuts, intermittent vomiting, procedural pro-mia/pro-ana advice, weakened gag response and blood. The transcript preserves every claim while the editorial layer rejects the ranking of anorexia or bulimia as effective, excludes purging instructions from previews, and distinguishes a recurring health-podcast joke from clinical authority. After the explicit six-person introduction, the episode turns to a growing Bible study at David's parents' home. Bill Poon's concealed Christianity, Steve's conversion and psychedelic departure, speaking in tongues, Andy Milonakis, karma, atheism, agnosticism, cult jokes and each participant's religious history build into David's account of forced baptisms, prison faith, bargaining with God, release from Japanese jail, giving away possessions and service as human purpose. The same discussion preserves Steve's reptilian, Pleiadian, Nibiru, lower-astral and child-fear claims as beliefs rather than fact. The crossroads moves from a devil bargain in Ralph Macchio's film to a practical decision metaphor. The second half ties service to labor: rather than hire Steve, David offers paid leave from Fat Sal's to record, discusses family and Brazil/Macau travel, then recounts a compulsive rebound after being catfished. He reports eight sexual sessions, persuading a doctor to prescribe tadalafil, shaving an unmeasured dose, palpitations, flushing, headache, rough sex after a partner begged him to stop, bleeding/injury claims, and a painful bump ultimately diagnosed as an ingrown hair. Medication, arousal and prior participation never override a stop. The title comes from the cast's simplified explanation that ED drugs still require being 'horny in your heart.' Private partners, athletes, medical records and images remain protected. The closing sections cover a hostess club, a webcam-performer date, an applicant, late-night fans and an escalating persistent-fan encounter that Critter resolves without violence. Music and film trivia supplies multiple proper-noun corrections. Twenty-seven empty records and one 22.16-second `mik` decoder loop are removed; the surrounding indistinct-audio marker and intelligible birthday/sign-off speech remain. Every idea and slur stays attributable, but dangerous instructions, private-person dossiers and named dialogue do not ship.
source_notes: Twenty-seven cleaner drops are empty zero-duration records. The remaining edit deletes a 22.16-second decoder loop containing `mik` roughly 218 times; intelligible speech resumes afterward.
Both health podcast rewrites are rejected because they replace literal speech with invented prose. Canonical DVDASA and cast-name repairs are accepted.
NIMH treats eating disorders as serious, sometimes fatal illnesses. The episode's anorexia/bulimia rankings, purge ordering, chew-spit system and blood normalization are not guidance.
FDA tadalafil labeling—not the cast's Viagra/Cialis comparison—governs safety. Shaving an unmeasured tablet, reusing it across partners and ignoring cardiovascular symptoms are not endorsed.
The opening names David Choe, Asa Akira, Money Mark, Steve Lee, Bill Poon and Critter. Zero turns/windows prohibits assigning lines.
Reptilians, Pleiadians, Nibiru, lower-astral planes, translated tongues and supernatural bargains are beliefs/testimony, not verified claims.
The woman who begged David to stop sets a consent boundary. Continued or earlier sex, medication, arousal, queefing and later contact cannot erase it.
Private partners, family, Bible-study attendees, applicants, fans, children, athletes, doctors, medical images and exact locations remain outside discovery metadata.
The persistent fan is not diagnosed as a pedophile. A troubling comment and boundary violation justify safety action, not an unsupported criminal label.
Historical venue/site references are not invitations. Poon Report and other fan resources require a separate current-link/provenance review before UI use.
speaker_policy: Episode metadata may name the explicitly introduced six public participants and later arrivals. With zero diarized turns and zero identity windows, no line is assigned to David Choe, Asa Akira, Money Mark, Steve Lee, Bill Poon, Critter, Bobby Lee, Valentin, Alex, Scrotum Coat or anyone else.

connections.why: Physical distance from Los Angeles is used to turn repeated album talk into sustained work.
The recurring joke sits beside procedural eating-disorder harm, not health authority.
Chewing without swallowing becomes another version of approaching experience while preserving escape.
Wrestling weight cutting supplies an early learned relationship between performance, weight and purging.
A private home becomes a growing religious/social institution without David's participation.
Steve links psychedelics to replacing Christianity with paranormal cosmology.
Glossolalia and placeholder vocals both use sound before stable meaning, for different purposes.
Bill refuses participation while others mock a practice he still respects.
A name and appearance produce a false transgender theory before basic identity is checked.
Goodwill can change relationships without requiring metaphysical karma.
A conversion film's threat of hell echoes later reptilian claims that fear controls humans.
Psychedelic perception and books explain conviction without proving lower-astral entities.
A supernatural bargain evolves into a framework for ordinary life choices.
Repeated baptism without assent produces retaliation rather than belief.
Prison faith is meaningful to David because he chose it, like adult therapy after forced childhood treatment.
The episode's religion debate converges on what a person does for others rather than doctrinal certainty.
Porn and DVDASA may accidentally teach, but performance should not be mistaken for comprehensive instruction.
Paid leave supports art without making a friend a permanent employee.
Catfishing grief triggers a manic sexual rebound rather than reflection.
A partner's willingness to cheat does not eliminate the other participant's moral agency.
A memorable phrase summarizes arousal dependence but not tadalafil's complete safety profile.
A request to stop overrides the narrator's goal, medication state and prior participation.
Search results turn one ingrown hair into STI certainty until a clinician examines it.
Poon Report shapes public perception and is also a potential secondary-source archive requiring provenance.
Recognition becomes unsafe when a fan ignores distance, follows movement and assumes access.
Only the decoder loop is removed; unresolved audio and later intelligible speech remain visible.

publication_restrictions.rule: Preserve eating-disorder evidence but exclude procedural purge ordering, chew/spit tips and blood normalization from casual snippets/how-to search.
Protect private sexual partner and conception/health identities.
Episode-level cast names do not license named dialogue; exact ranch access/schedule withheld.
Do not expose family home, Bible-study schedule, attendee identities or single-woman roster.
Religious beliefs remain attributed; do not convert slurs or mock performance into identity metadata.
Protect disabled relatives and childhood church participants; no diagnosis or possession claim.
Andy Milonakis may be named publicly; do not publish private attendees or infer transgender identity.
Paranormal/reptilian claims remain belief, not fact; do not create child/fear/person profiles.
Preserve forced-baptism/prison testimony while excluding private family, legal and bargain-performance details.
Protect private friends/family and do not present religious generalizations as doctrine.
Do not surface pornography as sex education without a clear caution.
Historical workplace/support details may be summarized; exclude shifts, correspondence, exact pay and current contact.
Travel and sex-tour discussions are proposals, not itineraries/invitations.
Private partners, athletes, spouses, photos, body details and encounter locations remain undiscoverable.
Do not turn prescription manipulation, tablet shaving, multi-session use or rough-sex descriptions into medical/sexual instructions.
The partner's request to stop is authoritative; exclude injury detail from erotic snippets.
Protect doctor, partner, athlete, medical images and genital history; clinician diagnosis does not authorize publication.
Do not map hostess venues/workers or create body metadata for Asa.
Protect young private webcam performer, applicant, spouse, contact data, date location and employment correspondence.
Do not identify persistent fan, children, event, car or security signal; behavior supports boundary action, not unsupported pedophilia diagnosis.
Historical fan meetup is not a current invitation; source-site links require current verification.
Trivia corrections may name public works/people but must preserve wrong guesses as guesses.
Retain indistinct-audio marker; remove only proven decoder repetition.
Retain intelligible post-loop speech and do not truncate at the false/early sign-off.
No line-level speaker names until independent held-out diarization/identity validation passes.
Warnings annotate ideas; they do not censor offensive, explicit, religious or implausible speech.
Private health, sex, family, employment and contact trails stay out of search facets and random-connection views.
Current FDA labeling and clinical care outrank cast medication/STI claims; no individualized treatment recommendation.
Current NIMH guidance outranks the episode's pro-ana/pro-mia claims; provide crisis/clinical context in health-facing UI.
Fan criticism may be quoted only with source provenance and without mobilizing harassment.
